question: Who was the first principal of the country's first school for girls in Pune?
solution:
The correct answer is **Savitribai Phule.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Savitribai Phule was India's first female teacher and social reformer.
 
• Along with her husband Jyotirao Phule, she founded the country's first school for girls in Pune.
 
• Savitribai Phule started this school for girls on 1 January 1848.
 
• Her main objective was to fight for the rights of women and Dalits in society and spread education.
 
• Savitribai Phule is considered an important figure in the Indian feminist movement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jyotirao Govindrao Phule****:**

 
 
• He was the husband of Savitribai Phule and a social reformer.
 
• He raised his voice against evils like casteism, untouchability, and child marriage.
 
• His major works include 'Gulamgiri'.
 
 
 
• **Women's education****:**
 
 
• Savitribai Phule stressed the need for women's education and did significant work in this direction.
 
• Her efforts gave women the right to receive education.
 
 **Social reform****:**

 
 
• Savitribai Phule and Jyotirao Phule tried to remove the inequalities prevailing in the society.
 
• They both believed in social reform through education.
 
 
 
• **Legacy of Savitribai Phule:​**
 
 
• Even today, Savitribai Phule's contributions are appreciated and she is considered an important leader of the Indian feminist movement.
 
• On her birth anniversary, various programs are organized and her works are remembered.
